feat(2d): import SVG drawings as 2D sketch profiles

A new SVG reader in camcraft-geometry reads paths, basic shapes, group
transforms, in-file use references, units and the viewBox into the same
primitives as the DXF reader. Chaining, nesting, the Sketch entity and the
project file are shared. Circular arcs stay arcs; Beziers and true
ellipses become lines within 0.005 mm. Y is flipped about the page.

An SVG with no physical size is refused until the caller states the unit
of one drawing unit; a sized file refuses a caller unit. Malformed input,
zero or negative sizes, degenerate arcs and over-budget files are refused
by name.

ImportSvg is the undoable command (it wraps ImportDxf's apply and
invert), with the import_svg MCP tool and the cam.importSvg script verb.

Fixes #1880

fix(svg): bound entity scan, refuse more transform sources, merge cusp pieces

- The entity decoder looks for `;` only in the next 12 bytes. A file with
  many `&` in one attribute no longer takes quadratic time.
- The reader refuses `transform-box` (attribute and inline CSS) and the
  inline CSS properties `translate`, `rotate`, `scale`, `offset` and
  `offset-path` by name.
- Curves flatten to half the chord bound. A short piece merges when the
  omitted vertices are within the other half of the replacement segment.
  A Bezier with a retracted handle (a cusp node) now imports within the
  chord bound.

fix(svg): find a duplicate attribute name with a set, not a scan

The duplicate check scanned all earlier attributes of the tag for each
new attribute. The time was quadratic in the attribute count of one tag,
and the element budget did not limit it: a hostile file inside the byte
budget could hold the reader for minutes. A set of the names read so far
makes the check linear. The first value of a repeated name stays.

Pinned by svg_many_attributes_on_a_tag_read_in_linear_time.

fix(svg): allow-list inline style properties and read each element's style one time

Second safety read on 573595e16, three blockers:

- A vendor-prefixed transform in an inline style (-webkit-transform) was ignored and the
  shape imported at the wrong size. An SVG 2 geometry property in an inline style
  (width, r, d) was ignored too. The reader now keeps an allow-list of the inline
  properties that cannot change geometry and refuses each other property by name, on the
  root and on each element whose geometry or children are imported.
- Each visit of a `use` target parsed its style and transform again, and each `use`
  searched all nodes for its id. The facts of a node are now read one time and kept by
  node index, an id map finds the target, and attributes are a map. Shape data is read
  at each visit, so each visit charges its attribute bytes against a work budget of
  4 x the byte budget.

Pins: crates/geometry/tests/svg_style_safety.rs.

fix(2d): SVG import refuses style sheets, animation and entities that change a shape

The delta safety read on eaafd2e72 found two cases where an input hides or
resizes a shape and the import ignored it, and four notes.

- A <style> sheet is checked with the allow-list of the inline styles, with
  no selector matching (svg/sheet.rs). display, visibility and each property
  that is not on the list are refused by name. A paint-only sheet imports.
  An xml-stylesheet instruction and a <link rel="stylesheet"> are refused.
- animate, set, animateTransform, animateMotion, animateColor and discard
  are refused by name at each place in the tree. A child of a shape or of a
  use that is not descriptive is counted as "<child> in <parent>".
- A reference to a DOCTYPE entity is refused by name in content and in an
  attribute value (xmlns declarations excepted).
- An unknown preserveAspectRatio value is refused.
- A marker property that draws a marker is counted as "marker".
- The guide says that a shape with a stroke imports as its centre line.

Pins: crates/geometry/tests/svg_tree_rules.rs (9 tests).

fix(2d): SVG import reads url( tokens and references as a browser does

Review of f96ea8fa0 on PR #3061, three findings.

1. A bad url( token hid the next declaration from the style check. The
   inline style and the style sheet now use one CSS scanner (svg/css.rs).
   An unquoted url( token ends at its first ')' that is not escaped; a
   quote, a '(', a ';', a brace or a '/*' in it starts nothing. A bad url
   token is refused by name in a sheet and in the inline style of an
   imported element.
2. A reference that the reader did not expand went through as text. One
   function (svg/reference.rs) finds a reference, decodes it and refuses
   what is not a character: an entity name outside ASCII, a run that is not
   an XML name, a code point that is not a character. A character reference
   is decoded with any count of leading zeros.
3. The five SVG test files of camcraft-geometry are one directory suite
   (tests/svg.rs with tests/svg/*.rs), and mcp_svg.rs is a module of the
   existing mcp suite (tests/mcp/svg.rs). The #[test] count is the same,
   plus the new pins.

Pins: tests/svg/url_tokens.rs (6 tests), tests/svg/references.rs (7 tests).
